# NFL Daily — 2026-08-29 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/29: Jaguars trade for Dolphins QB Quinn Ewers, sending a 2028 late-round pick back, as Jacksonville adds veteran QB depth. [RapSheet](https://x.com/RapSheet/status/2093800641596383589) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2093800983713230978)
- 08/29: Seahawks officially sign CB Terrion Arnold; the NFL plans to place him on the commissioner's exempt list once his contract is processed, given the kidnapping and armed-robbery charges he faces. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7546012/2026/08/29/terrion-arnold-signs-contract-seahawks/)

- 08/29: Packers RB Josh Jacobs was charged with two misdemeanors tied to an alcohol-related incident; coach Matt LaFleur says he "fully anticipates" Jacobs remaining on the roster. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49759295/matt-lafleur-fully-anticipate-josh-jacobs-packers)
- 08/29: Cowboys OLB Marist Liufau fractured his left forearm in Friday's preseason finale and is scheduled for surgery as early as Monday. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49759181/cowboys-marist-liufau-fractures-forearm-preseason-finale-set-surgery)
- 08/28: Jets RB Chip Trayanum was taken to the hospital with a neck injury after Thursday's game; the team says he is awake, alert and has movement in his extremities. [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2093513949169815625)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-08-29 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- 08/28: Ravens close a perfect 3-0 preseason, routing the Commanders 41-3 at M&T Bank Stadium. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-dominate-commanders-2026-nfl-preseason-undefeated)
- 08/29: Ravens trade DL C.J. Okoye to the Giants for a 2028 seventh-round pick, reuniting him with John Harbaugh and DL coach Dennis Johnson. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-trade-cj-okoye-giants-reports-john-harbaugh-dennis-johnson-reunited) — also [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49762578/sources-giants-acquire-dt-okoye-ravens-28-pick)

- 08/29: Roster trimming toward Sunday's 53-man deadline is underway but unconfirmed — Zrebiec reported cuts of WR Chris Moore, CBs Robert Longerbeam and Lardarius Webb Jr., and ILB Jamon Johnson, but RavensSalaryCap says the league's official transaction wire showed no releases yet Saturday night beyond the Okoye trade.
